node: Franchise royalty systems and unit-economics flywheel
summary: This pass expands the universe around the idea that restaurant franchise winners are not only the brand owners, but also the vendors that improve franchisee unit economics through procurement scale, kitchen productivity, digital ordering, loyalty, and approved-supplier relationships. The reference lane uses Domino's as the cleanest example of a franchisor whose royalty flywheel is reinforced by owned supply-chain and first-party demand capture. The underfollowed lane highlights kitchen equipment, restaurant software, and hidden beverage/coffee suppliers that may benefit when franchise systems pursue remodels, labor efficiency, procurement standardization, and digital engagement.
